report.question: Is axios@1.14.1 safe to install in our production backend?
assumptions: The package is axios from npm, exactly as written.
The repository axios/axios was taken from the latest npm release, because 1.14.1 is no longer on npm.
Nothing was checked on data collection, as axios is an HTTP client library and no personal-data use was stated.

licence.summary: MIT licence: permissive, keep the copyright notice.

maintenance.summary: Not archived, with commits and a release in November 2026.

privacy.summary: Not inspected; no personal-data use was stated.

findings.claim: Version 1.14.1 is a known malicious release (GHSA-fw8c-xr5c-95f9, MAL-2026-2307): do not install it.
axios 1.14.1 is a published malicious release. Do not install it anywhere.
findings.why: A malicious package can run attacker code on your servers and steal secrets.
findings.uncertainty: The advisory lists 1.14.1 and 0.30.4 as affected; other versions were not shown to be affected.

findings.claim: The newest release, 1.21.1, has no known vulnerabilities or malware reports in all sources that answered.
findings.why: This is the safe version to use instead of 1.14.1.
findings.uncertainty: No advisory does not prove the package is clean; verify provenance when installing.

findings.claim: Version 1.14.1 also carries several listed vulnerabilities, and it was removed from npm.
findings.evidence_quote: version 1.14.1 is no longer on npm (removed; this often happens to malicious releases)
findings.why: A removal fits the malware report; any existing install may come from a cache or lockfile.
findings.uncertainty: Why it was removed was not confirmed beyond the malware advisory.

findings.claim: axios is MIT licensed, so commercial backend use is allowed if you keep the copyright and licence notice.
findings.evidence_quote: Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy of this software
findings.why: No obligation to release your own source code.

findings.claim: The project is actively maintained: not archived, recent push, and a release on 2026-11-09.
findings.why: Security fixes are still being published for the 1.x line.

Pin axios to 1.21.1 exactly in the lockfile and re-check advisories before release.
